requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

weight_management_program.text:
ORTHOPEDICS — 04/24/2026
35 y/o M, R-handed, 6 weeks of left shoulder pain with reaching overhead and at night. Painful arc, positive Neer/Hawkins, cuff strength intact.
Dx: left shoulder impingement.
Plan: subacromial injection; home exercise program for rotator cuff and scapular stabilization 5x/week; activity modification. Follow-up 6 weeks.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 05/15/2026
S: 35 y/o M follow-up BP and weight. He has been working on eating less fast food and walking more; says it's "going OK." Shoulder better after injection. Mood stable.
O: Wt 106.3 kg, BMI 35.9. BP 138/80.

A/P:
1. Obesity — continue efforts with food choices and walking; encouraged.
2. HTN — BP 138/80 on lisinopril 10 mg daily; continue.
3. Anxiety — stable on sertraline.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/13/2026
S: Follow-up. He has been working on diet and exercise for the past several months — cutting back on fast food, walking most evenings. Weight 105.6 kg today, little change. Discouraged. Asks about medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis.
O: Wt 105.6 kg, BMI 35.7. BP 136/86.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 35.7 — Plan: start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard dose titration; counseled on GI side effects. Continue diet and walking. Recheck in 3 months.
2. Hypertension: BP 136/86 on lisinopril 10 mg daily; continue.

Pt asked about a potassium-containing salt substitute and magnesium. Cautioned that salt substitutes (potassium chloride) plus lisinopril can raise potassium — avoid unless cleared by PCP. Magnesium OK. No other interactions with sertraline, sumatriptan, cetirizine.
